metadata.camber_sign: positive means top of tire outward
metadata.caster_sign: positive means top of steering axis rearward
metadata.current_cam_rotation_viewpoint: looking from rear of truck toward front
metadata.historical_cam_rotation_viewpoint_for_se: not recovered; no CW/CCW conversion is used in this calculation
metadata.eccentric_cam_position_for_selected_pair: not recovered; preserve as unresolved rather than infer from nearby notes

steering_angle_input.kind: nominal model input, not direct observation
steering_angle_input.actual_road_wheel_angles_status: not measured numerically in recovered Sep10 record

historical_comparison.reported_for_passenger_symmetric_pairs: roughly 5-6 deg from the better half-turn / lock comparisons
historical_comparison.comparison_rule: primary agreement check is against the symmetric-pair historical range, not the separate all-data robust fit

do_not_import_as_evidence.reason: the legacy script explicitly labels these illustrative assumptions, not measured tolerances

uncertainty_policy.epsilon_rule: each named epsilon is retained symbolically with epsilon^2 = 0 for first-order bookkeeping; no rule for mixed epsilon_i*epsilon_j is assumed
